proposal.description: A host read leaves the OVERCURRENT bit in place, treating the window-trip record like the strike history that only a long clean run or rst_n clears, while every other cause bit is cleared
proposal.reason: After an overcurrent window trip has been recorded, a host read should return fault_reg to zero. With this fault it stays at 5'b00001, so the next read still reports OVERCURRENT, and a later cause no longer counts as the start of an episode, so fault_time stays zero.

proposal.description: The capture gate is held open while the protection latch reads back set, so that the analog OVP trip that stops the converter is sure to be recorded
proposal.reason: latch_state stays high until reset, so after an analog OVP trip the gate never closes. A UVLO or OTP that asserts after the converter has stopped is then recorded, and after a host read the still-live ovp sets the OVP bit again and stamps a new fault_time, so the record never stays clear.

proposal.description: fault_reg is cleared when it sees fault_time already cleared and the record non-empty, so its clear follows the read pulse through fault_time instead of using the pulse itself
proposal.reason: The record is cleared one clock after the read. A cause that asserts on the clock after the read is lost, because the late clear outranks capture on that clock. A record whose episode began while timestamp_ms was still 0 is also wiped on the next clock without any host read.
